Overview.Name: Charan Tej Nadendla
Overview.Food_Habit: I lose control if I start eating
Overview.Preference_Notes: Balanced – include non-veg but not in every meal

Meal_1: Option 1: 2 egg omelette + any 1 fruit (banana, apple, orange or papaya)
Option 2: Paneer cubes (40–50 g) + any 1 fruit (banana, apple, orange or papaya)
Option 3: RICE RAWA upma (small bowl ~150 g) + paneer cubes (40 g)
Meal_2: Option 1: ~Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & chicken curry or Fish curry(small portion) + Curd (small bowl)
Option 2: ~Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g)  & vegetable curry & Panner Cube (80g)
Option 3: ~Cooked rice (3/4 cup cooked ~110 g) & egg curry (1–2 eggs) & vegetable curry
Meal_3: Option 1: Cooked rice (3/4 cup cooked ~110 g) & egg omelette (1 egg) + any 1 fruit
Option 2: Cooked rice (3/4 cup cooked ~110 g) & paneer cubes (40–50 g) + any 1 fruit
Option 3: Cooked rice (3/4 cup cooked ~110 g)  & chicken curry (small portion)  & Curd (small bowl)

Notes_and_Tips: Avoid giving too many sweets as it can increase hyperactivity.
Include eggs, chicken or paneer daily for proper growth and energy.
Include ladies Finger and Beetroot in Vegetable curries.
Keep meals simple and consistent to improve focus and behaviour.
Ensure proper hydration and regular meal timing.
Light dinner helps better sleep and balanced energy the next day.
